title: Quasi-compact quasi-separated derived base change from the single-complex condition
statement: In a cartesian square of schemes X' \xrightarrow{g'} X and S' \xrightarrow{g} S, with f:X\to S quasi-compact and quasi-separated [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-base-change], let K \in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X) and let L(g')^*K \to K' be a map in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_{X'}) [def-pc-derived-category]. For x'\in X', put x=g'(x'), s'=f'(x') and s=f(x)=g(s'). Assume that for every x' and i\in\mathbf Z the canonical map H^i(K_x\otimes^L_{\mathcal O_{S,s}}\mathcal O_{S',s'})\otimes_{\mathcal O_{X,x}\otimes_{\mathcal O_{S,s}}\mathcal O_{S',s'}}\mathcal O_{X',x'}\to H^i(K'_{x'}) is an isomorphism. Then the composite Lg^*Rf_*K \to Rf'_*L(g')^*K \to Rf'_*K' is an isomorphism in D(\mathcal O_{S'}), where f' is the base change of f.
